policy: Discovery records leads. Inspect source, pin immutable revision, scan permissions/secrets, map overlap, and run validators before adoption.

sources.note: Vendor content is untrusted data; inspect provenance, license, scripts and requested permissions.

sources.auth: Vercel OIDC bearer token; search q >= 2 chars, limit 1-200; authenticated limit 600/min/team+project; 401 means token missing/expired.
sources.import_mode: candidate-metadata-first; fetch detail and audit only for selected candidates
sources.note: Search supports fuzzy single-word and semantic multi-word queries. Detail exposes content hash and file tree; audit endpoint aggregates partner security audits and returns 404 when none exist. Official CLI is npx skills; it collects anonymous telemetry by default (DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 opts out).

sources.auth: Hosted arena requires provisioned APPROX_TOKEN; offline ranking remains available.

sources.note: Published under google-labs-code, but its README explicitly says the project is not an officially supported Google product. Uses npx skills add google-labs-code/jules-skills --list; inspect skill scripts/assets and pin commit before use.
Supplied JSON describes bounded Discover/Find/Audit/Adapt/Craft/Run/Debrief/Save/Publish routes; the catalog host is a placeholder in the supplied material and must be resolved upstream.
Google product skills plus bundled plugins/MCP servers; README documents agent-specific plugin installation. Select a specific skill/plugin, inspect permissions and pin revision.

Current repository documentation uses google-labs-code/jules-invoke@v1 with JULES_API_KEY; issue-triggered invocation requires allowlists and PR review. The supplied PDF's older action name/GEMINI_API_KEY example requires correction before reuse.
